_meta.title: Horizon picks — 2026-11-17 through 2026-11-20
_meta.window_rule: the horizon is whatever data/derived/horizon_lines.json holds; that file is produced by the rolling-slate originator from the newest official schedule capture (today + up to 3 days ahead)
_meta.validation_state: NO strategy has passed the validation gates (Build A 0/8, Build B 0/10). Every pick is MODEL OUTPUT — UNVALIDATED, unfunded, zero stake. Market-comparison gates G4/G5 and prop-variance gate G-PROP remain BLOCKED (no odds feed).

side_and_total_rho.why: the rho a same-game side-and-total parlay needs

cross_game_rho.quantity: rho between two different games on the same date
cross_game_rho.why_not: two games have no natural pairing, so a number would be an artefact of how the pairs were made rather than a property of the games
cross_game_rho.consequence: cross-game parlays are published as the naive product p1 x p2 with the Frechet-Hoeffding band [max(0, p1+p2-1), min(p1, p2)]; no rho is asserted

parlay_pricing.rule: where a rho is measurable it is used; where it is not, the price is the naive product p1 x p2 printed beside the Fréchet–Hoeffding band — R14

registers.measured_rho_json: scripts/measure_rho.py — side/total on a rolling finals window; carries a 'not measurable' verdict for cross-game pairs
registers.rho_2026_27_json: session arena/801ba27f-nba1 — cross-game 0.0142 (n_pairs 1546), teammates -0.0975 (n=374), opponents +0.0321 (n=187), side/total -0.0199 (n=190), from official box-score pages
registers.conflict: the two registers disagree on cross-game measurability and on the side/total value (different corpus windows); both are published, conflict flagged F136

parlay_pricing.cross_game: price = joint under a Gaussian copula at the measured cross-game rho from rho_2026_27.json; the naive product p1 x p2 is printed beside it on every row (R14), with the Fréchet–Hoeffding band as the range any rho must respect
parlay_pricing.sgp_props: measured teammate/opponent rho from rho_2026_27.json where present, MODEL-DERIVED fallback labelled as such; naive product printed beside the rho price on every row (R14/F90)
parlay_pricing.side_and_total: priced with the measured rho on site/pages/roll.html section 4 from measured_rho.json (refreshed to its current 74-final corpus this session)
